To determine the 3 products with the fewest incidents in June of last year, you would need to query the "t_data_assistant_incident" table for the incident count for each product in June of the previous year, then rank the products based on the incident count.

1. Retrieve the incident count for each product in June of the previous year:

SELECT d37208_product_class_name AS Product_Name, SUM(d37208_incident_count) AS Total_Incidents
FROM t_data_assistant_incident
WHERE d37208_incident_month = 'June' and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d37208_incident_month) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1
GROUP BY d37208_product_class_name
ORDER BY Total_Incidents
LIMIT 3;

This query will return the 3 products with the fewest incidents in June of the previous year.

Please note that the actual query may vary based on the database system being used and the exact structure of the data.
